control_failures.control_label: arc flash boundary and protective equipment
application of positive isolation devices and personal locks
authorisation of switching and access to apparatus

facts.title: electrical release during an intrusive maintenance task on SG-7000

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was lost time injury, with 1 person injured and 4 days lost.

defences.finding: Control ARC_FLASH_PPE_AND_BOUNDARY: the arc flash boundary and protective equipment had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.
Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Restore the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks on SG-7000 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically switching, racking and access authorisation. SG-7000 (terminal switchgear) is in service for terminal distribution. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the arc flash boundary and protective equipment had degraded below its design intent. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 7 May 2024 an incident occurred on SG-7000 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during an intrusive maintenance task, releasing electrical energy held as HV switchgear.
